title: Aspiration and Implementation of National Education Policy (NEP) - 2020
content:
The National Education Policy (NEP) was approved by the Union Cabinet of India on July 28th, 2020. It aims to make India a world-class education and research hub. National Education Policy (NEP) reflects the aspirations of millions of students and it should be implemented in letter and spirit. To create awareness to students regarding NEP-2020- Aspiration and Implementation VTU has sent circular to conduct various events. Circular is attached for the reference.

Note:
Further Competitions will be conducted at university level for Winner and Runner.
